doc.name: AFMR Discovery
doc.instructions: Use this read-only server to discover AFMR 1.0 failure modes, reputation-attestation contracts, and configuration-scoped Lift Evidence artifacts. AFMR records are scoped to named evidence, configuration, governance process, and lifecycle state. They are not unqualified universal safety claims.

tools.name: discover_afmr
tools.title: Discover AFMR resources
tools.description: Return canonical AFMR specifications, registries, schemas, endpoints, and scope boundaries.

tools.name: lookup_failure_mode
tools.title: Look up AFMR failure modes
tools.description: Find exact AFMR 1.0 failure-mode records by permanent ID or bounded text query.

id.description: Exact permanent family identifier, for example AFMR-F010.

query.description: Text matched against ID, name, definition, and class.

tools.name: get_reputation_attestation_contract
tools.title: Get the reputation-attestation contract
tools.description: Return the portable attestation, trust-profile, verifier-result, endpoint-registry, and lifecycle contracts.

tools.name: get_lift_evidence_contract
tools.title: Get the Lift Evidence public-card contract
tools.description: Return the stable configuration-scoped public-card schema and empty public index; no results are asserted.

resources.name: Canonical AFMR failure-mode registry
resources.description: AFMR 1.0 machine index: 32 permanent failure-mode families in eight classes.

resources.name: Reputation attestation schema
resources.description: Working Draft 0.1 schema for a signed, scoped, lifecycle-aware AFMR reputation attestation.

resources.name: Reputation attestation verifier requirements
resources.description: Deterministic validation, proof, scope, evidence, and lifecycle requirements.

resources.name: Conforming governance-endpoint registry
resources.description: Intentionally empty pre-publication registry; no endpoint conformance is currently claimed.

resources.name: Lift evidence public-card index
resources.description: Configuration-only empty index. No measured lift results or safety claims are published.

resources.name: Lift comparison public-card schema
resources.description: Canonical stable redacted public-card contract for configuration-scoped cohort comparisons.
